# Londoco Ltd

> Londoco Ltd is a UK supplier (Bromley, England) of UK-manufactured pre-saturated solvent wipes, diamond and rotary precision tools, dental burs, and Masso TRS cold vulcanising conveyor belt adhesives. It serves aerospace, automotive, data centres, dental, engineering, marine, mining and rail customers.

Last updated: 2026-11-26

## Products
- [Pre-saturated wipes](https://londoco.com/wipes/): acetone, MEK, heptane, hydraulic, IPA, ethanol and data centre wipes
- [Precision engineering and industrial tools](https://londoco.com/tools/): diamond needle files, grinding pins, composite tools, sawing wheels
- [Conveyor belt adhesives (Masso TRS)](https://londoco.com/trs/): cold vulcanising adhesives and repair systems
- [Dental consumables](https://londoco.com/dental/): diamond burs and premium line burs
- [All products](https://londoco.com/products/)

## Wipes by contaminant
- [Acetone wipes](https://londoco.com/wipes/acetone/): uncured resin, polyester, ink
- [MEK wipes](https://londoco.com/wipes/mek/): cured sealant, adhesive, paint
- [Heptane wipes](https://londoco.com/wipes/heptane/): petroleum oil, grease, flux
- [IPA wipes](https://londoco.com/wipes/ipa/): fingerprints and light residue on electronics
- [Data centre wipes](https://londoco.com/wipes/datacentre/): cleaning of data centre and IT equipment

## Sectors
- [Sectors served](https://londoco.com/sectors/): [aerospace](https://londoco.com/sectors/aerospace/), [automotive](https://londoco.com/sectors/automotive/), [data centres](https://londoco.com/sectors/datacentres/), [dental](https://londoco.com/sectors/dental/), [engineering](https://londoco.com/sectors/engineering/), [marine](https://londoco.com/sectors/marine/), [mining](https://londoco.com/sectors/mining/), [rail](https://londoco.com/sectors/rail/)
